grades.reason: Describes WPRI reserved CSR fields (read-only zero when not implemented). It says nothing about the effect of writing to the constant-zero register x0.
Zimop MOPs write zero to x[rd]. That is not the same as writing to the zero register, and the passage does not discuss what happens when rd is x0.
The czero.eqz synopsis describes a conditional move of zero into rd. It does not cover the effect of writing to the hardwired zero register.
Covers world-switching and zeroing vsatp/hgatp to avoid HFENCE. It is unrelated to writes to the constant-zero register.
